invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new TableWriteStats object.
A method call is performed on writeMetadata, so it cannot be null at method exit.
getStats is initialized from a stream collect call, always yielding a non-null List.
The method maps over writeMetadata.getWriteStatuses(), so it must be non-null.
There is a one-to-one correspondence between WriteStatus objects and stats in the result.
